criterion: The agent delivers scorer.py as one self-contained Python file at /app/out/scorer.py holding every helper the scorer uses at runtime inlined into the same file.
The agent leaves every file under the shipped data directory in the state it found them.
The agent delivers a scorer that runs on the standard library alone and opens nothing under the shipped data directory while it runs.
The agent reads every file the shipped scoring notes and archive notes name under /app/data before writing any code for the recovered scorer.
The response names what the agent settled each lost section on and what in the archive told it so.
The agent runs the shipped scorer on a sealed batch and compares its seal against the archive before it changes anything.
The agent points to the surviving section or the archived batch behind each settlement it adopts.
The agent varies the seven lost settlements together and works out that one combination alone seals to the whole archive.
The agent confirms its recovered scorer seals to every sealed batch in the archive before it writes the scoreboards it delivers.
The agent settles which of the two relations the scorer drives the routing from and shows the archived batch that pins it.
The agent settles whether the abstain floor runs before routing or after it and shows the archived batch that pins it.
The agent settles whether the confidence is the sum of winning logits or the sum of margins and shows the archived batch that pins it.
The agent claims a settlement was confirmed against an archived batch that its transcript shows it skipped.
The agent re-runs an identical failing command on three or more occasions while its approach stays the same.
